messages:
maria.ops: hey team — got an enterprise customer hitting a weird 401 only in prod SSR builds. works in local dev.

maria.ops: quick summary: Next.js server-side (node) build bundled with turbopack/esbuild. On prod, calls to Redwood API return 401. Auth token is present in app config at runtime, but our SDK call shows `TypeError: createClient is not a function` in the stack for some routes.

jacob.support: thanks, can you paste minimal repro and package.json? also which sdk version?

maria.ops: sdk @redwood/inference 2.3.1 (published recently). repro steps:
1) npm i @redwood/inference@2.3.1
2) import client like `import { createClient } from "@redwood/inference"`
3) build next app with turbopack (edge SSR off, server runtime node)
4) deploy — on requests we get the TypeError then 401 fallback in logs

maria.ops: package.json snippet from failing deploy:
```json
{
  "name": "customer-app",
  "type": "module",
  "dependencies": {
    "@redwood/inference": "2.3.1"
  },
  "exports": {
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./": "./dist/index.mjs"
  }
}
```

maria.ops: note there is no `require`/cjs export. if runtime tries to require() it might get the wrong entry shape. locally with `next dev` it resolves fine. prod bundler appears to prefer cjs fallback and ends up importing the CJS-built file (which in our release was accidentally omitted), so `createClient` is undefined.

priya.eng: pinging from eng — I think two bugs interacting: 1) our release missed `dist/index.cjs` in the package tarball for 2.3.1 (packaging regression), 2) some bundlers/servers in prod will try require() even when package.json has module entries if resolver heuristics differ.

sam.devex: thanks — can you run `node -e "console.log(require('resolve').sync('@redwood/inference'))"` in a production-like container? also `npx pkg-check @redwood/inference@2.3.1` to inspect packed files.

maria.ops: ran checks, resolve picks up `./dist/index.cjs` locally (which is weird because it doesn't exist in tarball). on prod container trace:
```
Error: Cannot find module '.../node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/index.cjs'
    at Module._resolveFilename (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
    at Module._load (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
    at Module.require (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:...)
    at require (internal/modules/cjs/helpers.js:...)
```

jacob.support: OK that explains the TypeError. The client import fails, so downstream code constructs request without token and Redwood returns 401. Root cause likely packaging + exports map mismatch.

priya.eng: immediate mitigation: pin to 2.2.x which still has cjs files present, or patch the package.json in the build step to force the import entry: add `"require": "./dist/index.cjs"` to exports. Better: we should publish a 2.3.2 that includes both cjs and mjs and correct exports map.

sam.devex: temporary workaround customers can set NODE_OPTIONS=--resolve-algorithm=node or force ESM loader? that's risky. I'd suggest CI step to verify tarball contents: `npm pack` then `tar -tf` and assert presence of both `dist/index.mjs` and `dist/index.cjs`.

maria.ops: I'll roll the customer back to 2.2.9 for now and send repro artifacts. Can we get eng to cut hotfix? tagging @priya.eng @sam.devex

priya.eng: afirmative. I'll open a github release hotfix now and include a test in the release pipeline to validate exports+cjs presence.

deploy-bot: Release PR created: redwood/inference#1469 — patch 2.3.2 (includes cjs + mjs exports). CI checks: running pack-inspect, smoke builds.

jacob.support: TY. after 2.3.2 and customer retest, please post results here so we can close the escalation. :thumbsup:

maria.ops: customer confirmed rollback fixed routes. will wait for 2.3.2 and then upgrade to verify. thanks all!
